info.title: Hub Planner Universal API
info.description: Hub Planner, now part of Milient Resource Management, provides resource planning, project scheduling, bookings, timesheets, vacations, groups, clients, and related resource management data through a REST API.

get.description: Retrieves a billing rate from Hub Planner.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Hub Planner billing rate ID from the _id field.

schema.description: Hub Planner billing rate ID from the _id field.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
